tokens.colormap.bipolar.note: Zero always maps to the ground colour, so silence and neutrality look like the background.
tokens.colormap.categorical-6.cb.note: lightness-separated so it survives greyscale printing; pair with the label/dash encoding always
tokens.colormap.categorical-6.note:
Order matters: the first five ARE the signal classes, so a category colour never contradicts a signal
colour. The sixth (warning yellow) is reserved. A seventh category is a design error - merge or facet.
tokens.colormap.dna_tree.depth.note: lineage depth encoded by lightness, never by hue - the tree must read in monochrome
tokens.colormap.greyscale.note: for printing, documentation, and when colour would mislead
tokens.colormap.inferno-class.note: perceptually uniform reference map (viridis family); used for analysis where accuracy beats identity
tokens.colormap.phosphor.cb.note: deuteranopia/protanopia-safe: identical lightness ramp, hue restricted to blue->green->yellow
tokens.colormap.phosphor.note: Use with log magnitude scaling for audio spectra.
tokens.colormap.rig_map.heat.note: per-speaker level heat on the overhead rig map
tokens.colormap.spectrum.sonogram.freq_axis: bottom-to-top, log by default, linear optional
tokens.colormap.thermal.note: non-default; permitted for density/heat displays where the audience expects it
tokens.layout.canvas.wire_crossing_policy: no bridges; crossings are drawn plain (data-ink)
